{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(trial)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {trial['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(trial) - trial['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(trial['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch B and its unit issue
print(f"Assay_batch B count: {(trial['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum()}")

# Check severity and arm distributions
print("\nArm distribution:")
print(trial['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(trial['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if there are control patients with moderate severity
control_mod = trial[(trial['arm'] == 'control') & (trial['severity'] == 'moderate')]
print(f"Control arm, moderate severity patient count: {len(control_mod)}")

# Note: We will deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# First, verify that sample_seq is per-patient
print("\nSample_seq max per patient (should be 1 or 2):")
print(trial.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())"}
